questions.question:
FROM:

TO:

SUBJECT:

SENT:

 Robert Bremen

Glenn Cameras Customer Service

Product return

February 9, 10:51 A.M.

 
I recently purchased a battery for my camera from your Web site. The online description said that the battery would be compatible with my camera, but it’s the wrong size. What do I need to do to return this battery and get the right one for my camera?

Thanks,

Robert Bremen
Directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are a customer service representative. In your e-mail, give TWO pieces of information and ask ONE question.
questions.model_answer:
Hello Robert, Lời chào
We are sorry about the confusion. There should be a return label in the package you received (thông tin 1). You can use any box to send the battery back. Just attach the label (thông tin 2). Can you send me your order number (câu hỏi)? Once I received it, I will refund the cost of shipping. - Thông tin 1: có nhãn dán trả lại trong gói hàng bạn đã nhận - Thông tin 2: Bạn có thể dùng bất kỳ hộp nào để trả pin, chỉ cần dán nhãn lên - Câu hỏi: Bạn có thể gửi cho tôi số đơn hàng được không?
Thank you, Glenn Cameras Ký tên

FROM:

SUBJECT:

SENT:

 M.Lee

Explore The City Tour Company

Sightseeing tours

June 14, 9:46 A.M.
I will be staying in your city for five days in July. I’d like to see some interesting places during that time. Could you please give me some information about the sightseeing tours that your company offers?
Directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you work for a tour company. In your e-mail, give TWO pieces of information and ask ONE question.
questions.model_answer:
Hi, Lời chào
Are you interested in a bus tour or a walking tour (câu hỏi)? We offer both types of tours, and all of our tours are led by experienced guides (thông tin 1). We have tours that focus on the city’s historic sites, tours that visit the city’s cultural sites, and tours that introduce our most popular destinations (thông tin 2). Let us know what you are interested in. - Câu hỏi: Bạn hứng thú với tour đi xe buýt hay đi bộ? - Thông tin 1: Chúng tôi cung cấp 2 loại tour, và các tour đều có hướng dẫn viên đầy kinh nghiệm. - Thông tin 2: Chúng tôi có tour tham quan di tích lịch sử, tour tham quan di tích văn hóa và tour giới thiệu về địa điểm nổi tiếng nhất.
Sincerely, Explore The City Tour Company Ký tên

questions.question: Do you think it is important for high school students to take a class on public speaking? Why or why not? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
questions.model_answer:
Mở bài I believe that students should take a public speaking class in high school. They would not only learn how to successfully give presentations in front of large groups of people, but they would also become more comfortable speaking to people in general. Public speaking skills could also boost a student’s self-confidence. Trình bày các luận điểm: - Biết cách thuyết trình - Thoải mái nói hơn - Tăng sự tự tin
Thân bài 1 (Biết cách thuyết trình) Learning how to successfully present in front of large groups of people will be beneficial to students who continue on to college. If students want to succeed in their college classes, they should be able to give a good presentation. Learning how to make eye contact and how to avoid reading off written materials is important. - Phân tích: Việc biết cách thuyết trình sẽ có ích rất nhiều khi học sinh tiếp tục lên đại học. Nếu muốn thành công ở lớp đại học sẽ cần phải biết thuyết trình. Biết cách giao tiếp bằng mắt và biết cách tránh việc đọc những gì đã viết rất quan trọng
Thân bài 2 (Thoái mái nói hơn) Public speaking courses will also prepare students for their future careers. They should know how to give an informative presentation because they may end up working in an environment where they need to give lots of presentations. Some students may end up working as teachers and will be speaking to groups of people the entire day. In order to be a good teacher, individuals should be able to clearly explain concepts to their students. This requires good public speaking skills. In the business world, employees are expected to be able to give presentations, even if they do not have to do it all the time. - Phân tích: Học sinh cần biết cách trình bày các thông tin vì có thể họ sẽ làm trong môi trường mà họ phải thuyết trình nhiều. Vài học sinh sẽ làm giáo viên và sẽ nói với những nhóm người cả ngày. Để làm giáo viên tốt, cá nhân cần biết cách giải thích cho học sinh. Trong môi trường làm việc, nhân viên cần biết cách thuyết trình.
Thân bài 3 (Tăng sự tự tin) Finally, people who are comfortable with public speaking will eventually become comfortable speaking to people in general. Some people find it just as difficult to speak to one or two people as it is to speak to 20 or 100 people. Public speaking courses help teach students to deal with nervousness and shyness. The more they practice, the more confident they feel talking to people. Therefore, public speaking courses can help give students more self-confidence since they can talk to people without feeling shy. - Phân tích: Vài người thấy việc nói với 1-2 người cũng khó như nói với 20-100 người. Khóa học sẽ giúp học sinh xử lý với sự lo lắng và sự ngại ngùng. Họ càng luyện tập thì họ càng trở nên tự tin nói chuyện với mọi người.
Kết bài I think high school students would benefit from public speaking courses. They could help students in college and their careers. They can also help build the students’ confidence and their ability to talk to people without being nervous or shy. Tổng hợp luận điểm và nêu quan điểm cá nhân.

intro.content:
Question 1-5: Write a sentence based on a picture

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write ONE sentence that is based on a picture. With each picture, you will be given TWO words or phrases that you must use in your sentence. You can change the forms of the words and you can use the words in any order. Your sentences will be scored on

  • the appropriate use of grammar and
  • the relevance of the sentence to the picture

In this part, you can move to the next question by clicking on Next. If you want to return to a previous question, click on Back. You will have 8 minutes to complete this part of the test.

Example

 Sample response: This man is writing in a notebook.

Question 6-7: Respond to a written request

Directions: In this part of the test, you will show how well you can write a response to an e-mail.

Your response will be scored on

  • the quality and variety of your sentence,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 10 minutes to read and answer each e-mail

Click on Continue to go on.

Question 8: Write an opinion essay

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write an essay in response to a question that asks you to state, explain, and support your opinion on an issue. Typically, an effective essay will contain a minimum of 300 words. Your response will be scored on

  • whether your opinion is supported with reasons and/or examples.
  • grammar,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 30 minutes to plan, write, and revise your essay.

Click on Continue to go on.
